description.value: The Veranda is a seasonal open-air patio at the iconic Fairmont Empress, perched above Victoria's Inner Harbour with sweeping views of the water and the heart of the city. Operating on both upper and lower levels, it is one of Victoria's most celebrated outdoor dining spots and a natural landmark on any harbour-front cycling route. As part of the Fairmont Empress, the venue carries the full service infrastructure of a grand historic hotel established in 1908.
